firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: 6-word 2-line h1 with trade + place, filled primary + outline Call, phone in header, Sample proof line, sign + hung sheet signature, next band peeks ~56px. 390-first.jpg: sheet crop + sign + h1 + both actions above fold; proof line below fold and sheet crop clips the roof.

distinctiveness.notes: 1440-full.jpg: street signs (hero, picker, 4 stops, footer) and numbered sheets SHEET 00-06 (now including the form) organise navigation, services, checklist output and form; differs from siblings A/B. Price tags and 3x2 review grid are standard shapes.

type.notes: 1440-full.jpg: Aleo/Figtree with real scale contrast, en-dash price ranges, no heading orphans. 1440-first.jpg: 3 tiny tracked mono caps labels in the hero view (-0.5); 1440-full.jpg contact hours use spaced hyphens '7:30 am - 5 pm'.

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg: 12 single-job sections, clean tone alternation, full-bleed skyline, varied sheet placement per stop; contact columns now end level. Footer at 1440 leaves right two-thirds empty above the nav row.

photo.notes: 1440-full.jpg: one consistent drawn sheet system, Highlands now a full bungalow with hall section cut; honest illustration disclaimer in footer; nothing blank. 390-first.jpg: hero sheet crop loses roof and gable.

copy.notes: 1440-full.jpg / dist/index.html: trade- and house-native lines, honest 'Where we stop', CTAs unified on 'Price ...', Sample labels on prices and reviews, claims trace to facts.json. Review tag lines repeat service h3s verbatim (1440-full.jpg reviews).

mobile.notes: 390-full.jpg: no sideways scroll (render.json), full-width 48px 'Next step', sign-list picker, sign-sheet-h2-fixes order per stop, stacked footer contacts, brass mobile bar. 390-first.jpg: proof line below fold, clipped sheet crop.

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg / 390-rm-full.jpg: every word, sign and sheet present; one h1, no skips, focus-visible, forced-colors, skip link, live regions in dist/index.html. 1440-scroll-75.jpg: checklist checkbox edges faint on light teal.

motion.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg / 1440-scroll-50.jpg: sheet swing, route draw, sign flip (present in 1440-rm-full.jpg), checklist marks; route is still a thin dashed gutter rule, no single retellable motion idea. Unchanged since round 3.

wow.notes: 1440-scroll-75.jpg: Derby checklist tied to trade, city, season; porch drawing shows as-found faults matching rows. Result is a one-line cream box; output never becomes a keepable sheet with visit type and range.

polish.notes: 1440-full.jpg / 390-full.jpg: default Next button gone, inspection rows clean, SHEET 06 form frame. 1440-full.jpg stop 4: 'Price my report list' is the one red filled primary among brass ones.

elevate.move: Make the walk the motion: one route line from the hero sheet's nail down through each stop's sign post into its sheet title block, each sign turning to face the reader as the line arrives and the sheet number ticking up, ending at SHEET 06, the form.

Make the checklist's output a sheet: ticking boxes rewrites the porch drawing's title block (SHEET 05 · YOUR PORCH, 3 FIXES MARKED) and stamps a result strip in the drawn language (visit type, Sample range, time) whose 'Send this sheet' carries the ticked list into SHEET 06.
